actions.adjust_inventory.description: Adds or removes stock for an item variation. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.adjust_inventory.props.idempoten: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.adjust_inventory.props.item.desc: Pick a catalog item. Type to search by name.
How many units to add or remove, for example 5 or 1.5.
actions.adjust_inventory.props.variation: The item variation (size, color, ...). Items without options have a single "Regular" variation.
actions.adjust_inventory_by_id.descripti: Adds or removes stock for an item variation by ID.
actions.adjust_inventory_by_id.props.ide: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.adjust_inventory_by_id.props.qua: Positive number of units, for example 5 or 1.5.
actions.adjust_inventory_by_id.props.var: Item variation ID from Search Catalog Items.
actions.create_catalog_item.description: Adds a product or service with one price to the Square catalog.
actions.create_catalog_item.props.catego: The catalog category for the item.
actions.create_catalog_item.props.curren: Three-letter code such as USD. Leave empty to use your main location currency.
actions.create_catalog_item.props.idempo: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
For example 12.50. Leave empty for a variable price set at checkout.
actions.create_catalog_item_by_id.descri: Adds a product or service with one price to the Square catalog, using a category ID.

actions.create_customer.description: Adds a customer profile to the Square Customer Directory.
actions.create_customer.props.birthday.d: YYYY-MM-DD, or 0000-MM-DD when the year is unknown.
actions.create_customer.props.country.de: Two-letter country code, for example US.
actions.create_customer.props.idempotenc: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.create_customer.props.phone_numb: Phone number in international format, for example +14155550123.
actions.create_customer.props.reference_: Your own ID for this customer, for example from your CRM.
actions.create_order.description: Creates an open order (no payment is taken).
actions.create_order.props.customer_id.d: Optional. Type part of a name or email to search.
actions.create_order.props.idempotency_k: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.create_order.props.line_items.de: What the order contains. Pick a catalog item, or leave Catalog Item empty and fill Custom Name and Custom Price.
actions.create_order.props.location_id.d: The Square location (store) to use. Leave empty for your main location.
Your own ID for this order, for example from your web shop.
actions.create_order_by_id.description: Creates an open order from variation IDs or custom items.
actions.create_order_by_id.props.idempot: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.create_order_by_id.props.locatio: Square location ID (from List Locations). Leave empty to use the main location.
actions.create_payment_link.description: Creates a Square checkout link for a fixed amount that you can send to a buyer. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.create_payment_link.props.curren: Leave empty to use the location currency.
actions.create_payment_link.props.descri: Internal description, not shown to the buyer.

actions.create_payment_link.props.locati: The Square location (store) to use. Leave empty for your main location.
actions.create_payment_link.props.name.d: What the buyer pays for, shown on the checkout page.
actions.create_payment_link.props.redire: Where to send the buyer after paying.
actions.create_payment_link_by_id.descri: Creates a Square checkout link for a fixed amount at a location ID.

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_catalog_object.descriptio: Permanently deletes a catalog item (with all its variations) or a single variation.
actions.delete_customer.props.customer_i: Pick a customer. Type an email to search all customers, or part of a name to search up to the 10,000 newest (the search stops after 20 seconds). For an older customer, search by email or map the Customer ID.
actions.delete_customer_by_id.descriptio: Permanently deletes a customer profile by customer ID.
actions.find_customers.description: Searches customers by email, phone, reference ID or creation date.
actions.find_customers.props.cursor.desc: Next Cursor from a previous run, to get the next page. Cursors expire after about 5 minutes.
actions.find_customers.props.limit.descr: How many results to return (1-100, default 50).
actions.find_customers.props.match.descr: Exact match, or partial match (contains) for email, phone and reference ID.
actions.get_catalog_item.description: Gets a catalog item with its variations and prices.
actions.get_catalog_item.props.object_id: The catalog item ID, or one of its variation IDs (from Search Catalog Items or an order line item).
actions.get_customer.props.customer_id.d: Pick a customer. Type an email to search all customers, or part of a name to search up to the 10,000 newest (the search stops after 20 seconds). For an older customer, search by email or map the Customer ID.
actions.get_customer_by_id.description: Gets a customer profile by customer ID.
actions.get_inventory_count.description: Gets the stock count of an item variation. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.get_inventory_count.props.item.d: Pick a catalog item. Type to search by name.
actions.get_inventory_count.props.locati: Leave empty to get the count at every location.
actions.get_inventory_count.props.variat: The item variation (size, color, ...). Items without options have a single "Regular" variation.
actions.get_inventory_count_by_id.descri: Gets stock counts for one or more item variations by ID.

Item variation IDs from Search Catalog Items.
actions.get_merchant.description: Gets the connected Square business: name, country, currency and main location.
actions.get_order.description: Gets an order with its line items and totals.
actions.get_order.props.order_id.descrip: Map it from the New Order trigger or a payment.
actions.get_payment.description: Gets a payment with its amount, status and card summary.
actions.get_payment.props.payment_id.des: Map it from the New Payment trigger or List Payments.
actions.get_refund.description: Gets a refund and its status.
actions.list_locations.description: Lists the business locations (stores) of the Square account.
actions.list_payments.description: Lists payments in a time range, newest first.
actions.list_payments.props.cursor.descr: Next Cursor from a previous run, to get the next page. Cursors expire after about 5 minutes.
actions.list_payments.props.limit.descri: How many results to return (1-100, default 50).
actions.list_refunds.description: Lists refunds in a time range, newest first.
actions.list_refunds.props.cursor.descri: Next Cursor from a previous run, to get the next page. Cursors expire after about 5 minutes.
actions.list_refunds.props.limit.descrip: How many results to return (1-100, default 50).
actions.list_team_members.description: Lists staff members of the Square account. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.list_team_members.props.cursor.d: Next Cursor from a previous run, to get the next page. Cursors expire after about 5 minutes.
actions.list_team_members.props.limit.de: How many results to return (1-200, default 50).
actions.list_team_members.props.location: Square location ID (from List Locations). Leave empty to use the main location.
actions.record_external_payment.descript: Records money you received outside Square (cash, check, bank transfer, another app). Never charges a card. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.record_external_payment.props.cu: Leave empty to use the location currency.
actions.record_external_payment.props.ex: For Other payments: the provider, for example "Venmo" or "Bank of X".
For Other payments: how the money was received.
actions.record_external_payment.props.id: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
actions.record_external_payment.props.lo: Leave empty to use the main location.
actions.record_external_payment.props.or: Optional order this payment pays for.
actions.refund_payment.description: Refunds all or part of a payment. Card refunds send real money back to the buyer and cannot be undone. Needs a connection created or reconnected with piece version 1.0.0 or later.
actions.refund_payment.props.amount.desc: Decimal amount in the payment currency, for example 12.50. Must not exceed what is left to refund.
actions.refund_payment.props.idempotency: Optional, up to 45 characters. Leave empty: a retried step returns the same record, but identical calls in one run (such as a loop with the same input) count as one. Set a unique value, like the loop item, to keep them separate.
Map it from the New Payment trigger, Get Payment or List Payments.
actions.refund_payment.props.reason.desc: Shown to the buyer on the refund receipt.
actions.search_catalog_items.description: Finds products and services in the Square catalog by name, category or location.
actions.search_catalog_items.props.curso: Next Cursor from a previous run, to get the next page. Cursors expire after about 5 minutes.
actions.search_catalog_items.props.limit: How many results to return (1-100, default 25).
actions.search_catalog_items.props.locat: Only items enabled at this location.

actions.search_orders_by_id.description: Finds orders by location IDs, state, customer ID and creation date.

actions.search_orders_by_id.props.locati: Up to 10. Leave empty for all active locations.

actions.set_inventory_count.props.quanti: The counted number of units, for example 12.
actions.set_inventory_count.props.variat: The item variation (size, color, ...). Items without options have a single "Regular" variation.
actions.set_inventory_count_by_id.descri: Sets the in-stock count of an item variation by ID.
